chapter: Films, Las Vegas and the union
title: The New Orleans set photo and the other people in it
summary: Callender identifies Mantan Moreland, Frenchy Landry and Susan Harbin in a photo from the 1947 film, and says Harbin is married to Calvin Bailey.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: We also had a listing in this book for New Orleans, 1947.
That was the picture with Louis. Did we talk about that before?

I believe we talked about this picture in Jazz People where you identified all the musicians. But interestingly, in this book Jazz In The Movies, there is another picture, apparently taken at the same time with the same musicians, but it's a different shot... But the thing that makes it even more interesting than the one in Jazz People is the other people that show in the picture on the set. And you identified some of them that you remember. Mantan Moreland.
That's Mantan; he was a chef. And that's Clarence Landry; they called him Frenchy...
He was in Jump For Joy.
Jump For Joy. And that's Susan Harbin...
Who was also in Jump For Joy.
Mmm-hmm, and who's married to the great artist Calvin Bailey, who is my... Calvin and I went to school together...
